title: The SSF conformance PR added GET/PATCH/PUT stream handlers plus stream verify and status views without the add_stream provider permission check that the existing POST handler enforces, so any token holder for the app can read, modify, verify and disable its event streams.

findings.explanation: No SQL queries or string concatenation with user input detected in the diff. The view only performs permission checks and uses ORM methods.
All stream management endpoints now explicitly check that the requesting user has the "add_stream" permission on the provider before proceeding, preventing unauthorized access or modifications.
